name: Chroma/Depth Background Separation
purpose: Isolate foreground player character from background geometry for localized color treatments.
required_visual_conditions: High contrast or distinct color difference between character and background.
required_source_footage: Clean CS2 demo footage or green screen HLAE stream.
required_masks_or_mattes: DeltaKeyer chroma matte or rotoscope polygon mask.
fusion_node_structure:
MediaIn1 (Background) -> ColorCorrector1 (Sat: 0.8) 
MediaIn2 (Foreground Key) -> DeltaKeyer1 -> Merge1 over Background -> MediaOut1
resolve_implementation_instructions: Fusion Page: DeltaKeyer isolates character, background node desaturated and blurred slightly, composite with clean alpha.
qa_procedure: Inspect hair and weapon barrel edges for green/fringing artifacts.
